arguments.title: Apple & Banana | MomoTime
arguments.lyrics:
[Intro - 4 bars, instrumental, no vocals, no count-in]

[Verse 1 - 4 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Here is an apple.
Apple, apple!
I see an apple.

[Chorus - 8 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Sing along with me.
Banana, banana!
Sing and clap with me!

[Verse 2 - 4 bars, sung, no instrumental gap]
Banana, banana!
Here is a banana.
Banana, banana!
I see a banana.

[Chorus - 8 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Sing along with me.
Banana, banana!
Sing and clap with me!

[Bridge - 4 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Can you say apple?
Banana, banana!
Can you say banana?

[Final Chorus - 8 bars, sung]
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Banana, banana!
Apple, apple!
Sing along with me.
Banana, banana!
Sing and clap with me!

[Outro - 2 bars, sung]
Apple, banana!
Bye-bye, bye-bye!

[End - one final chord, stop]
arguments.style: playful kids funk disco, 112 bpm, four-on-the-floor groove, light slap bass, clean rhythmic funk guitar, short muted brass accents, warm cheerful boy solo voice, relaxed delivery, simple singable melody with a narrow range, very clear English pronunciation, apple in two syllables, banana in three syllables with the stress on NA, one short lyric line per bar, leave space between repeated words, 4-bar instrumental intro with no spoken count-in, sing every verse and chorus in the written order, no instrumental break between sections, sung 2-bar outro, one final chord then stop, approximately 90 to 110 seconds
arguments.negative_style: spoken count-in, instrumental interlude, rap, screaming, distorted vocals, long fade-out
